name: spellingbeeapp
description: A web application for practicing spelling bee words. An admin manages a shared word library. Parents create child profiles and assign lists. Children practice via two modes: Spelling Bee (type the word from audio) and Flashcards (see the definition, then reveal the word). Progress and difficulty ratings are tracked per child.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=app && rm -rf dist && cp -r app/dist dist
